name: 179. Responses computer_call batched actions (computer-call-actions)
description:
Newer models batch computer actions into an actions array on a computer_call item instead of the singular action (observed on gpt-6.1-sol: "actions": [{"type": "screenshot"}] with "action": null). schemas.ResponsesComputerToolCall (core/schemas/responses.go) modelled only the older shape - it carried pending_safety_checks and nothing else - and computer_call is not a raw-preserved item type, so it goes through field-level decode and sonic dropped the unknown key. The field was gone by the time providerUtils.HandleProviderResponseCtx returned and nothing later could recover it. The client received a computer_call with a call_id and no instruction, so it could not tell it should take a screenshot and the computer-use loop stalled.

Fix: add Actions []ResponsesComputerToolCallAction `json:"actions,omitempty"` to ResponsesComputerToolCall. The embedded struct already round-trips through ResponsesMessage, so request and response directions are both covered by the one field. The singular Action is deliberately NOT synthesized from actions[0] - inventing a field the wire did not send would be a capability claim, and a unit test pins that it stays nil.

Case: a replay carrying a computer_call with actions plus its computer_call_output asserts both directions - the replayed item still carries its actions on the outbound wire (raw_request), and the model's own returned computer_call reaches the client with a non-empty actions array and its call_id intact.
